def factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_simplified(df):
    """Smooth lower-wick absorption in drawdowns while removing a noisy auxiliary attenuation block."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    eps = np.finfo(float).eps
    safe_close = close.clip(lower=eps)
    bar_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    lower_wick = ((np.minimum(open_, close) - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    close_location = ((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
    absorption = (lower_wick * close_location).rolling(16, min_periods=16).mean()
    high_water = safe_close.rolling(50, min_periods=50).max().clip(lower=eps)
    depth = (1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0)
    prior_close = safe_close.shift(1)
    downside_damage = (-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0).rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum()
    signal = depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage)
    df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_simplified"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_simplified"]
